content:
Let \(x>0\), and set

\[
t=\log_{2026}x.
\]

Then \(x=2026^t\). The equation becomes

\[
\sqrt[20]{x^{\log_{2026}x}}=26x
\]

\[
\left(x^t\right)^{1/20}=26x
\]

\[
x^{t/20}=26x.
\]

Substitute \(x=2026^t\):

\[
2026^{t^2/20}=26\cdot 2026^t.
\]

Taking \(\log_{2026}\) of both sides,

\[
\frac{t^2}{20}=\log_{2026}26+t.
\]

Let \(c=\log_{2026}26\). Then

\[
t^2-20t-20c=0.
\]

The two roots \(t_1,t_2\) satisfy

\[
t_1+t_2=20.
\]

Thus the product of the two corresponding positive values of \(x\) is

\[
2026^{t_1}\cdot 2026^{t_2}=2026^{t_1+t_2}=2026^{20}.
\]

Now factor:

\[
2026=2\cdot 1013,
\]

and \(1013\) is prime. Therefore

\[
2026^{20}=2^{20}\cdot 1013^{20}.
\]

The number of positive divisors is

\[
(20+1)(20+1)=21^2=441.
\]

\[
\boxed{441}
\]
